subject: Commercial exception request: starter-credit uplift for Springboard Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@springboardhealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Starter credit proposal for Springboard onramp

Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great alignment on the integration timeline. Per our discussion, attached is a clean starter-credit proposal that gets Springboard to a predictable onramp while keeping unit economics intact:

- 3-month starter credit covering 60% of estimated token consumption for the initial POC
- Optional burst capacity for month 2 (additional fees if used)
- 12-month term, convertible to committed tier after month 3

Quick ask from my side: if you need a written exception to standard commercial guardrails (the 60% starter credit exceeds our standard policy), let me know and I will route a formal memo for VP/CFO signoff.

Attaching: proposal_Springboard_v1.pdf and a brief usage forecast.

Next steps: if this looks good I'll draft a compact mutual action plan and loop in procurement.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@springboardhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@springboardhealth.com
Date: 2026-06-30T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Starter credit proposal for Springboard onramp

Ben — thanks for the PDF. We reviewed internally and want to move ahead, but procurement is pushing for a deeper starter concession to cover integration risk and regulatory validation:

- Request: 75% starter credit for months 1-2, 50% month 3 (instead of 60% across 3 months)
- Packaging ask: include VPC deployment option in month 1 at no additional setup fee

They described it as a gating item for the legal and tech teams. If you can get an exception routed to your CFO/VP that approves the higher starter credit and the VPC packaging waiver, we can sign within the week.

Sam Tucker
Head of Partnerships, Springboard Health
sam.tucker@springboardhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Starter credit proposal — Springboard requests exception (75% initial)

Folks — forwarding the thread with Springboard. Key points: they want a larger upfront starter credit (75% months 1-2, 50% month 3) and a waived VPC setup fee. Attachments: original proposal + their usage estimate.

Why this matters: the account is strategic (clinical integrations across 3 major hospital systems) and the ARR upside is ~USD 1.1M over 12 months if we land the committed tier post-onramp. The requested concession exceeds commercial guardrails: typical max starter credit we approve is 60% for two months.

Proposal for signoff workflow:
- Kimberly: can you run a quick unit-economics / margin model with the attached forecast?
- Jordan: seeking VP-level commercial exception to approve credit uplift and VPC fee waiver conditional on: 1) 12-month committed conversion clause and 2) documented SLA expectations for VPC deployment
- Marissa: if you can provide CFO sign-off language or escalate to finance committee, we can close this by EOD Friday.

I drafted a short exception memo (comm_exception_memo.docx) that distills terms, financial impact, and risk mitigations.

Thanks — Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Starter credit proposal — Springboard requests exception (75% initial)

Ben / Kimberly — reviewed the memo and forecast. I am prepared to approve a limited commercial exception with the following conditions:

1) Starter credit cap: 75% for months 1-2, 50% for month 3 (as requested). Total not to exceed the dollar-value in comm_exception_memo.docx.
2) Conversion requirement: Springboard must convert to a minimum committed tier (12 months) at the end of month 3 or reimburse the prorated difference on a sliding scale.
3) VPC setup: waive the setup fee if they sign the commitment and agree to a 30-day tech readiness milestone; any bespoke engineering beyond standard onboarding will be charged.
4) Legal: include a short amendment documenting the concession and the reimbursement ladder. Legal to own final DocuSign.

Ben — please:
- Send the final terms to Sam and procurement with a draft amendment link (DocuSign attached in related_links).
- Confirm the exact dollar cap so finance can record the concession against DEAL-4821-SB.

This exception is time-boxed: approval expires 10 business days from today if not executed.

Marissa Cole
Chief Financial Officer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
